source: NUS EduRec Course Mappings Search exports under data/mapping/ (retrieved by the owner on 2026-10-14); partner_university ids captured read-only from the live partner_universities table on 2026-10-26
policy: A link means the named NUS faculty can exchange with the partner for that faculty, verified through the EduRec export named in provenance (the owner's copy of NUS's official course-mapping search).
Availability is never inferred from rows in the mappings table: the database mapping import is downstream of these same exports, so it is not independent evidence.

University-wide agreements are expanded into one explicit link per faculty; when a new faculty is added, this file must be re-reviewed and the seed re-run so the expansion is repeated (contracts.md, DB-02).
Availability for any faculty not listed here is unknown and stays unlinked until reviewed.
